messages:
Maria K.: Quick sync — planning a schema migration for console_events to address uneven partitioning and slow quota rollups. moving from route_id-based partitioning -> route_tag bucketing. objective: reduce hot shards, speed up per-route quota/day aggregation, and simplify dashboard joins.
AJ: SGTM. timeframe? any expected downtime?
Maria K.: No downtime planned. proposal: dual-write for 48h, then backfill and swap reads via a feature flag in console. canary on 2 low-volume tenants first.
Leo T.: Curious about the new partition key. route_tag is a small enum, right? will that create skew too for top tags?
Maria K.: Good call. route_tag is smaller than route_id but can still skew. plan is hierarchical bucketing: (route_tag, tenant_bucket) where tenant_bucket = farm_hash64(tenant_id) % 256. reduces hotness while keeping daily queries efficient.
Sasha P.: What's the plan for historical queries/dashboards? we can't break console metrics that reference route_id.
Maria K.: We'll add a read adapter in the analytics layer that resolves route_tag from route_id for legacy queries during the transition. dashboards will default to route_tag aggregates after flip.
Irene C.: Backfill cost estimate? GPU/CPU and S3 egress?
Maria K.: Rough numbers: ~500M rows, ~2TB compressed. Backfill via streaming worker with checkpointing. estimate ~8h on current fleet if we parallelize by partition. cost ~ $1.2k compute + S3 ops. open to optimizing via incremental backfills.
AJ: Any schema DDL we can glance at?
Maria K.: Yup, draft SQL below:
```sql
BEGIN;
ALTER TABLE console_events ADD COLUMN route_tag text;
-- populate route_tag (safe idempotent function)
UPDATE console_events SET route_tag = coalesce(route_tag, route_tag_from_meta(route_id));
-- add tenant_bucket for hot shard mitigation
ALTER TABLE console_events ADD COLUMN tenant_bucket smallint;
UPDATE console_events SET tenant_bucket = (farm_hash64(tenant_id) % 256)::smallint;
-- create partitioning scheme
CREATE TABLE console_events_rt PARTITION OF console_events FOR VALUES WITH (MODULUS 256, REMAINDER 0);
-- (actual partition creation will be scripted per bucket/day)
COMMIT;
```
Leo T.: We should avoid large table locks. run updates in chunks and use `pg_rewrite` pattern?
Sasha P.: Also add a shadow index on (route_tag, day) before switching reads. minimizes query regressions.
Maria K.: Agreed — plan: 1) add columns (cheap), 2) backfill in parallel using chunked SELECT/INSERT, 3) create indexes concurrently, 4) enable dual-write and read-adapter, 5) canary reads, 6) flip default flag.
Irene C.: How will quota calculation change? current pipeline aggregates by route_id across TTL windows.
Maria K.: We'll change aggregator to group by (route_tag, tenant_bucket) and then map to route_id if needed for per-route quotas. For strict per-route quotas we still compute a secondary mapping step. That should be cheaper since tag cardinality << route_id.
AJ: Who owns the read-adapter and dual-write?
Maria K.: Owners: migration scripts & backfill -> Leo T.; read-adapter & aggregator changes -> Sasha P.; rollout & canary -> AJ; dashboards & QA -> Irene C.
DeployBot: deploy scheduled: migration-runner v0.9 -> staging at 2026-03-22T02:00Z :rocket:
Sasha P.: Need automated smoke checks: compare pre/post aggregates for a sampled window (24h). add regression alert if >2% diff.
Maria K.: +1. I'll add eval harness and tie to the rollout pipeline.
Leo T.: Risk notes: large tenants with dynamic tagging may see transient quota double-counting during dual-write. recommend throttled ramp for those tenants.
Irene C.: I'll reach out to the top 5 tenants to schedule maintenance windows and inform them of canary groups.
Maria K.: Cool. I'll write the migration playbook and link it here when done. Next sync friday 10am to confirm scripts and canary list. :white_check_mark:
